lines.en: I am Peppa Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。

lines.en: This is my little brother, George.
lines.zh: 这是我的弟弟，乔治。

lines.en: This is Mummy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈。

lines.en: And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: It is raining today, so Peppa and George cannot play outside.
lines.zh: 今天在下雨，所以佩奇和乔治不能出去玩。

lines.en: Daddy, it's stopped raining. Can we go out to play?
lines.zh: 爸爸，雨停了。我们可以出去玩吗？

lines.en: All right. Run along, you two.
lines.zh: 好吧。你们两个去玩吧。

lines.en: Peppa loves jumping in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 佩奇喜欢在泥坑里跳。

lines.en: I love muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 我喜欢泥坑。

lines.en: Peppa! If you jump in muddy puddles, you must wear your boots.
lines.zh: 佩奇！如果你要在泥坑里跳，就必须穿上靴子。

lines.en: Sorry, Mummy.
lines.zh: 对不起，妈妈。

lines.en: George likes to jump in muddy puddles, too.
lines.zh: 乔治也喜欢在泥坑里跳。

lines.en: George! If you jump in muddy puddles, you must wear your boots.
lines.zh: 乔治！如果你要在泥坑里跳，就必须穿上靴子。

lines.en: Peppa likes to look after her little brother, George.
lines.zh: 佩奇喜欢照顾她的弟弟乔治。

lines.en: George, let's find some more puddles.
lines.zh: 乔治，我们再去找些泥坑吧。

lines.en: Peppa and George are having a lot of fun.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治玩得很开心。

lines.en: Peppa has found a little puddle. George has found a big puddle.
lines.zh: 佩奇找到了一个小泥坑。乔治找到了一个大泥坑。

lines.en: Look, George! There's a really big puddle!
lines.zh: 看，乔治！那里有个非常大的泥坑！

lines.en: George wants to jump into the big puddle first.
lines.zh: 乔治想第一个跳进那个大泥坑。

lines.en: Stop, George! I must check if it's safe for you.
lines.zh: 停下，乔治！我得先检查对你是否安全。

lines.en: Good, it is safe for you.
lines.zh: 很好，对你来说是安全的。

lines.en: Sorry, George. It's only mud.
lines.zh: 对不起，乔治。只是泥而已。

lines.en: Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢在泥坑里跳。

lines.en: Come on, George, let's go and show Daddy.
lines.zh: 来吧，乔治，我们去给爸爸看看。

lines.en: Goodness me! Daddy! Daddy! Guess what we have been doing?
lines.zh: 我的天哪！爸爸！爸爸！猜猜我们刚才在做什么？

lines.en: Let me think. Have you been watching television?
lines.zh: 让我想想。你们刚才在看电视吗？

lines.en: No, Daddy.
lines.zh: 不是，爸爸。

lines.en: Have you just had a bath?
lines.zh: 你们刚洗完澡吗？

lines.en: No, no.
lines.zh: 不是，不是。

lines.en: I know! You have been jumping in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 我知道了！你们刚才在泥坑里跳。

lines.en: Yes, yes, Daddy! We've been jumping in muddy puddles!
lines.zh: 是的，是的，爸爸！我们刚才在泥坑里跳！

lines.en: Ho-ho. And look at the mess you are in.
lines.zh: 呵呵。看看你们弄得多脏。

lines.en: Ew! Oh, well.
lines.zh: 咦！哦，好吧。

lines.en: It's only mud. Let's clean up quickly before Mummy sees the mess.
lines.zh: 只是泥而已。我们赶紧清理干净，别让妈妈看到这团乱。

lines.en: Daddy, when we have cleaned up, will you and Mummy come and play, too?
lines.zh: 爸爸，等我们清理干净，你和妈妈也来一起玩好吗？

lines.en: Yes, we could all play in the garden.
lines.zh: 好啊，我们可以一起在花园里玩。

lines.en: Peppa and George are wearing their boots. Mummy and Daddy are wearing their boots.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治穿着他们的靴子。猪妈妈和猪爸爸也穿着他们的靴子。

lines.en: Peppa loves jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 佩奇喜欢在泥坑里跳上跳下。

lines.en: Everyone loves jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 大家都喜欢在泥坑里跳上跳下。

lines.en: Oh, Daddy Pig. Look at the mess you are in.
lines.zh: 哦，猪爸爸。看看你弄得多脏。

lines.en: It's only mud.
lines.zh: 只是泥而已。
